rows.label: Under-five mortality rate (2024)

source.title: UN IGME estimates, via World Bank World Development Indicators API

rows.explainer: Probability of dying before age five per live birth in Côte d'Ivoire, 2024, UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (IGME) as republished by the World Bank (64.5 per 1,000, stored as a share). National average; the IGME uncertainty interval is not carried here.
